items.title: Mosaic: The Art Hidden in Bitcoin
items.summary: How generative artist BitArt is transforming sats into a collective visual and musical composition, and why Bitcoin Art Society believes the network could become a permanent medium for contemporary art. This post Mosaic: The Art Hidden in Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Dennis Koch .

Bitcoin lending and yield could drive next wave of institutional demand, Rootstock says
items.summary: A new report argues that putting institutional Bitcoin holdings to work through lending, collateral and financing could create demand beyond its store-of-value role.

items.title: Bitcoin drops to $80,000 on Fed dissent, Samsung, Alphabet earnings; AI tokens slump
items.summary: Bitcoin fell 1.4% since midnight UTC to around $80,100 as disappointing reports from Samsung and Alphabet weighed on tech stocks. The Fed's preferred inflation gauge is due later today.

items.title: Bitcoin long-term resistance in focus as analysis sees selling risk above $85K

items.title: Thai Supreme Court rules bitcoin is property after thief challenges conviction
items.summary: The court said bitcoin has a market price, can be cashed out and held by the public. It upheld a 10-year sentence for a man who helped the robbers.
